function getMissileImgPath(level)
    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        hit_count = 1
    elseif hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = 
hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then
        missile_count = 4
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        missile_token = addChildToken(
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.6, 1, 0.6),
            {"missile_token", "missile_4"}
        )
        
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(missile_token))
        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

function fireMissile()
    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then
        missile_count = missile_count - 1
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end

function getMissileImgPath(level)
    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )

function getMissileImgPath(level)
    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

    prepToken()

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    end

    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)

    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do

function getMissileImgPath(level)
    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        hit_count = 1
    elseif hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = 
hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then
        missile_count = 4
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        missile_token = addChildToken(
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.6, 1, 0.6),
            {"missile_token", "missile_4"}
        )
        
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(missile_token))
        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

function fireMissile()
    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then
        missile_count = missile_count - 1
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end
end --I should like to thank MrStump, who has already done all the legwork which I shamefully steal.
--Set this to true while editing and false when you have finished
disableSave = false
buttonFontColor = {-1,-1,-1,15}
buttonColor = {1,1,1,0.4}
buttonScale = {1,1,1}

defaultButtonData = {
    textbox = {
                	{
          pos       = {0.0,0.8,-0.49},
		          rot       = {-60.0,0.0,0},
          rows      = 2,
          width     = 3880,
          font_size = 370,
          label     = "Click here to edit your\nname & pronouns!",
          value     = "",
          alignment = 3
	                },

        }
}

--[[buttonScale = {0.4,0.4,0.4}
    
        }
]]

--Save function
function updateSave()
    saved_data = JSON.encode(ref_buttonData)
    if disableSave==true then saved_data="" end
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

--Startup procedure
function onload(saved_data)
    if disableSave==true then saved_data="" end
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        ref_buttonData = loaded_data
    else
        ref_buttonData = defaultButtonData
    end

    spawnedButtonCount = 0
    createTextbox()
end



--Updates saved value for given text box
function click_textbox(i, value, selected)
    if selected == false then
        ref_buttonData.textbox[i].value = value
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Dud function for if you have a background on a counter
function click_none() end

function createTextbox()
    for i, data in ipairs(ref_buttonData.textbox) do
        --Sets up reference function
        local funcName = "textbox"..i
        local func = function(_,_,val,sel) click_textbox(i,val,sel) end
        self.setVar(funcName, func)

        self.createInput({
            input_function = funcName,
            function_owner = self,
            label          = data.label,
            alignment      = data.alignment,
            position       = data.pos,
            			rotation       = data.rot,
            scale          = buttonScale,
            width          = data.width,
            height         = (data.font_size*data.rows)+24,
            font_size      = data.font_size,
            color          = buttonColor,
            font_color     = buttonFontColor,
            value          = data.value,
        })
    end
end     saved_data = JSON.encode(ref_buttonData)

    self.script_state = saved_data
end

--Startup procedure
function onload(saved_data)
    if disableSave==true then saved_data="" end
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        ref_buttonData = loaded_data
    else
        ref_buttonData = defaultButtonData
    end

    spawnedButtonCount = 0
    createTextbox()
end

    if selected == false then
        ref_buttonData.textbox[i].value = value
        updateSave()
    end
end

    for i, data in ipairs(ref_buttonData.textbox) do
        --Sets up reference function
        local funcName = "textbox"..i
        local func = function(_,_,val,sel) click_textbox(i,val,sel) end
        self.setVar(funcName, func)

        self.createInput({

            function_owner = self,
            label          = data.label,

            position       = data.pos,

            font_size      = data.font_size,
            color          = buttonColor,
            font_color     = buttonFontColor,
            value          = data.value,
        })
    end
end MSL_4_IMG = "https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/13975766137257302393/91C63BB27A88589C427CF7327ED998BD7496D1CE/"

function getMissileImgPath(level)
    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        hit_count = 1
    elseif hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = 
hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,

local trayStaticColor = nil

-- this function is used to detect if a game object is a counter or
-- not, tweak this if your counters aren't being detected by default
function isCounter(o)
   if not o then
      return false
   end
   return o.name == "Custom_Tile" and o.getScale().x < 2
end

   if saved_data and saved_data ~= "" then

      for k, guid in ipairs(loaded_data) do

                     {

                        triggerObj=obj
                     }
                  )
               end
            )
         end
      end
   end

   addHotkey("explode", function (player, obj)
                if (obj ~= nil) and isCounter(obj) then
                   explodeStack({player=Player[player], triggerObj=obj})
                end
   end)
   
end

      obj.addContextMenuItem("Explode Stack", function (player)
                                explodeStack({player=Player[player], triggerObj=obj})

function onSave()
   local counters = {}
   for k, obj in ipairs(getAllObjects()) do
      if isCounter(obj) then
         table.insert(counters, obj.getGUID())
      end
   end
   saved_data = JSON.encode(counters)
   return saved_data
end

function getTrayCounters(tray)
   local bounds = tray.getBounds()
   local objs = findRight(
      {
         pos = {
            (bounds.center.x-bounds.size.x/2),
            bounds.center.y+5,
            bounds.center.z
         },
         size = {
            0.1,
            10,
            bounds.size.z,
         },
         distance = bounds.size.x
      }
   )
   
   table.sort(
      objs,
      function(a, b)
         local posA = a.getBounds().center
         local posB = b.getBounds().center
         if posA.x == posB.x or (math.abs(posA.x - posB.x) <= 0.1) then
            return posA.y < posB.y
         end
         return posA.x > posB.x
      end
   )

   return objs
end

function repack (player, value)
   local tray = getObjectFromGUID(value)
   if tray then
      local placeholder = getObjectFromGUID(tray.getVar("placeholder"))
      if placeholder then
         placeholder.destruct()
      end
      local btn = getObjectFromGUID(tray.getVar("btn"))
      if btn then
         btn.destruct()
      end

      local origin = tray.getTable("stackOrigin")

      local objs = getTrayCounters(tray)


      for i, o in ipairs(objs) do
         if isCounter(o) then
            local pos = {
               x = origin.x,
               y = origin.y+(i*0.25),
               z = origin.z,
            }
            o.setPositionSmooth(pos, false, true)
            o.use_grid = true
            o.use_snap_points = false
         end
      end
      tray.destruct()
      trayCount = trayCount - 1
   end
end

function move(player, value, panelID)
   -- log(player, "exploder.move")
   -- log(value, "exploder.move")
   -- log(panelID, "exploder.move")
   local tray = getObjectFromGUID(value)

   if tray == nil then
      return
   end

   local btn = getObjectFromGUID(tray.getVar("btn"))
   if btn == nil then
      return
   end

   local cursorPos = player.getPointerPosition()
   local curPos = tray.getPosition()
   local trayBounds = tray.getBounds()

   local objs = getTrayCounters(tray)

   local trayScale = getTrayScale(objs)

   tray.setScale(trayScale)

   
   local trayPos = Vector(cursorPos.x, curPos.y, cursorPos.z+1)
   local trayScale = tray.getScale().x

   local testTrayCollision = function ()

      local objList = Physics.cast({
            origin=trayPos - Vector(trayBounds.size.x/2, 0, 0), direction={1, 0, 0}, type=3,
            size={0.1, 0.15, trayBounds.size.z + 1.25}, max_distance=trayBounds.size.x,
            debug=false
      })
      -- log(objList, "testCollision")
      if #objList > 0 then
         local needsMove = false
         for i, hit in ipairs(objList) do
            if not isCounter(hit.hit_object) then
               local hitGUID = hit.hit_object.getGUID()
               if hitGUID ~= tray.getGUID() and hitGUID ~= btn.getGUID() then
                  needsMove = true
               end
            end
         end
         if needsMove then
            trayPos:setAt('z', trayPos.z + 0.5)
            return false
         end
         return true
      end
      return true
   end

   local moveTray = function (pos)
      
      tray.setPosition(pos, false, true)

      btn.setPosition(pos - Vector(0, 0, trayBounds.size.z/4), false, true)


      -- log(objs)
      -- log(reverseTable(objs))

      layoutCounters(reverseTable(objs), tray, {
                        x = pos.x,
                        y = pos.y,
                        z = pos.z,
      })

   end

   Wait.condition(
      function ()
         moveTray(trayPos)
      end,
      function ()
         return testTrayCollision(tray.getGUID(), trayPos, trayBounds.size)
      end
   )


   
   
   -- tray.interactable = true
   -- tray.setLock(false)
   -- tray.addToPlayerSelection(player)
   
end

function reverseTable ( tab )
   local size = #tab
   local newTable = {}

   for i,v in ipairs ( tab ) do
      newTable[size-(i-1)] = v
   end

   return newTable
end

function getTrayScale(objs)
   local objWidth = 0
   local objHeight = 0
   for i, o in ipairs(objs) do
      local oSize = o.getBounds().size
      objWidth = objWidth + oSize.x
      if oSize.z > objHeight then
         objHeight = oSize.z
      end
   end

   return Vector(objWidth + (0.25*(#objs+1)), 0.1, objHeight * 1.5)
end

function explodeStack(params)
   local player = params.player
   local triggerObj = params.triggerObj
   if not isCounter(triggerObj) or triggerObj.getVar("exploded") then
      return
   end
   -- log("exploding from " .. triggerObj.getName())

   local bounds = triggerObj.getBounds()

   local objs = findBelow({bounds.center.x, bounds.center.y+0.9, bounds.center.z})
   -- log(objs, "exploder.explodeStack")

   if #objs < 2 then
      if objs[1].getPosition().y > 1.5 then
         return
      end
   end
   
   table.sort(objs, function(a, b)
                 local posA = a.getBounds().center
                 local posB = b.getBounds().center
                 return bounds.center.y - posA.y < bounds.center.y - posB.y
   end)

   -- log(objs)bounds.center.z
   -- log(#objs)

   local trayScale = getTrayScale(objs)

   local trayPos = Vector(bounds.center.x+0.5+ (trayScale.x/2), bounds.center.y + 3, bounds.center.z)

   local testCollision = function ()
      local objList = Physics.cast({
            origin=trayPos, direction={1, 0, 0}, type=3,
            size={trayScale.x, 0.15, trayScale.z+1.25}, max_distance = 0.01,
            debug=false
      })
      if #objList > 0 then
         trayPos:setAt('z', trayPos.z + 0.5)
         return false
      end
      return true
   end

   local spawnTray = function()

      trayCount = trayCount + 1
      local trayNumber = trayCount
      
      local tray = spawnObject({
            type              = "BlockSquare",
            position          = trayPos,
            rotation          = {0, 0, 0},
            scale             = trayScale,
            callback_function = function (o)
               o.setLock(true)
               o.setColorTint({0, 0, 0, 0})
               o.setTable("stackOrigin", bounds.center)
               o.setTable("stackObjs", objs)
               o.setVar("number", trayNumber)
               o.interactable = false
               local tray = o


               spawnRepackButton(o)

               local trayColor = layoutCounters(objs, tray, trayPos)

               -- local factor = math.random(1, 2) / 2
               -- trayColor:set(trayColor.r * factor, trayColor.g * factor, trayColor.b * factor)
               tray.setColorTint(trayColor)

               local placeholderY = objs[#objs].getPosition().y
               local placeholderPos = Vector(bounds.center.x, placeholderY, bounds.center.z)
               
               spawnPlaceholder(tray, placeholderPos)


            end,
            sound             = false,
            snap_to_grid      = false,
      })

   end

   Wait.condition(spawnTray, testCollision)

end

function layoutCounters(objs, tray, trayPos)
   local traySnaps = {}

   local traySize = tray.getBounds().size
   local posX = (trayPos.x-(traySize.x/2))+0.25

   local colorTotals = {r = 0, g = 0, b = 0}
   local counterCount = 0
   for i, o in ipairs(objs) do
      if isCounter(o) then
         local oSize = o.getBounds().size
         posX = posX + (oSize.x/2)
         local pos = {
            x = posX,
            y = trayPos.y + 0.5,
            z = trayPos.z,
         }
         counterCount = counterCount + 1
         local cColor = o.getColorTint()
         colorTotals.r = colorTotals.r + cColor.r
         colorTotals.g = colorTotals.g + cColor.g
         colorTotals.b = colorTotals.b + cColor.b
         table.insert(traySnaps, {position=tray.positionToLocal({pos.x, trayPos.y, pos.z})})
         o.setPositionSmooth(pos, false, true)
         o.use_snap_points = true
         o.use_grid = true
         o.removeFromPlayerSelection(table.concat(o.getSelectingPlayers(), "|"))
         
         posX = posX + (oSize.x/2) + 0.25
      end
   end

   
   tray.setSnapPoints(traySnaps)

   if trayStaticColor ~= nil then
      return trayStaticColor
   end
   
   local tint = Color(colorTotals.r/counterCount, colorTotals.g/counterCount, colorTotals.b/counterCount, 0.75)
   local threshold = 0.5
   local reduction = 0.25
   while tint.r > threshold or tint.g > threshold or tint.b > threshold do
      tint:setAt('r', tint.r * (1-reduction))
      tint:setAt('g', tint.g * (1-reduction))
      tint:setAt('b', tint.b * (1-reduction))
   end
   -- return 
   return tint
end

--Set this to true while editing and false when you have finished
disableSave = false
buttonFontColor = {-1,-1,-1,15}
buttonColor = {1,1,1,0.4}
buttonScale = {1,1,1}

defaultButtonData = {
    textbox = {
                	{
          pos       = {0.0,0.8,-0.49},
		          rot       = {-60.0,0.0,0},
          rows      = 2,
          width     = 3880,
          font_size = 370,
          label     = "Click here to edit your\nname & pronouns!",
          value     = "",
          alignment = 3
	                },

        }
}

--[[buttonScale = {0.4,0.4,0.4}
    
        }
]]

--Save function
function updateSave()
    saved_data = JSON.encode(ref_buttonData)
    if disableSave==true then saved_data="" end
    self.script_state = saved_data
end

--Startup procedure
function onload(saved_data)
    if disableSave==true then saved_data="" end
    if saved_data ~= "" then
        local loaded_data = JSON.decode(saved_data)
        ref_buttonData = loaded_data
    else
        ref_buttonData = defaultButtonData
    end

    spawnedButtonCount = 0
    createTextbox()
end



--Updates saved value for given text box
function click_textbox(i, value, selected)
    if selected == false then
        ref_buttonData.textbox[i].value = value
        updateSave()
    end
end

--Dud function for if you have a background on a counter
function click_none() end

function createTextbox()
    for i, data in ipairs(ref_buttonData.textbox) do
        --Sets up reference function
        local funcName = "textbox"..i
        local func = function(_,_,val,sel) click_textbox(i,val,sel) end
        self.setVar(funcName, func)

        self.createInput({
            input_function = funcName,
            function_owner = self,
            label          = data.label,
            alignment      = data.alignment,
            position       = data.pos,
            			rotation       = data.rot,
            scale          = buttonScale,
            width          = data.width,
            height         = (data.font_size*data.rows)+24,
            font_size      = data.font_size,
            color          = buttonColor,
            font_color     = buttonFontColor,
            value          = data.value,
        })
    end
end label = "Supply"
text_color = {0,0,0,1}
min_val = 0
val = tonumber(self.getName()) or 10
max_val = tonumber(self.getDescription()) or 20

-- Updates name/description + the counter display
function name_update()
    self.setName(tostring(val))
    self.setDescription(tostring(max_val))
    self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val})
    self.editButton({index=1, label = val .. "/" .. max_val}) -- update display
end

-- Big invisible button for clicks
self.createButton({
    tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "increment_val",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.5,0},
    height = 1500,
    width = 1500,
    color = {0,0,0,0}
})

-- Handles increment/decrement when clicking
function increment_val(obj, player_clicker_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and 1 or -1
    local new_val = math.min(math.max(val + mod, min_val), max_val)
    if val ~= new_val then
        val = new_val
    end
    name_update()
end

-- Counter display (centered, single block)
self.createButton({
    label = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,0.9}, -- center
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 300,         -- change this to make 0/100 smaller/bigger
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

-- Label at the bottom
self.createButton({
    label = "- " .. label .. " +",
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,1.4},  -- push down
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 250,
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

label = "Supply"
text_color = {0,0,0,1}
min_val = 0
val = tonumber(self.getName()) or 10
max_val = tonumber(self.getDescription()) or 20

-- Updates name/description + the counter display
function name_update()
    self.setName(tostring(val))
    self.setDescription(tostring(max_val))
    self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val})
    self.editButton({index=1, label = val .. "/" .. max_val}) -- update display
end

-- Big invisible button for clicks
self.createButton({
    tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "increment_val",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.5,0},
    height = 1500,
    width = 1500,
    color = {0,0,0,0}
})

-- Handles increment/decrement when clicking
function increment_val(obj, player_clicker_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and 1 or -1
    local new_val = math.min(math.max(val + mod, min_val), max_val)
    if val ~= new_val then
        val = new_val
    end
    name_update()
end

-- Counter display (centered, single block)
self.createButton({
    label = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,0.9}, -- center
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 300,         -- change this to make 0/100 smaller/bigger
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

-- Label at the bottom
self.createButton({
    label = "- " .. label .. " +",
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,1.4},  -- push down
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 250,
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

label = "Supply"
text_color = {0,0,0,1}
min_val = 0
val = tonumber(self.getName()) or 10
max_val = tonumber(self.getDescription()) or 20

-- Updates name/description + the counter display
function name_update()
    self.setName(tostring(val))
    self.setDescription(tostring(max_val))
    self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val})
    self.editButton({index=1, label = val .. "/" .. max_val}) -- update display
end

-- Big invisible button for clicks
self.createButton({
    tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "increment_val",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.5,0},
    height = 1500,
    width = 1500,
    color = {0,0,0,0}
})

-- Handles increment/decrement when clicking
function increment_val(obj, player_clicker_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and 1 or -1
    local new_val = math.min(math.max(val + mod, min_val), max_val)
    if val ~= new_val then
        val = new_val
    end
    name_update()
end

-- Counter display (centered, single block)
self.createButton({
    label = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,0.9}, -- center
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 300,         -- change this to make 0/100 smaller/bigger
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

-- Label at the bottom
self.createButton({
    label = "- " .. label .. " +",
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,1.4},  -- push down
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 250,
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

label = "Supply"
text_color = {0,0,0,1}
min_val = 0
val = tonumber(self.getName()) or 10
max_val = tonumber(self.getDescription()) or 20

-- Updates name/description + the counter display
function name_update()
    self.setName(tostring(val))
    self.setDescription(tostring(max_val))
    self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val})
    self.editButton({index=1, label = val .. "/" .. max_val}) -- update display
end

-- Big invisible button for clicks
self.createButton({
    tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "increment_val",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.5,0},
    height = 1500,
    width = 1500,
    color = {0,0,0,0}
})

-- Handles increment/decrement when clicking
function increment_val(obj, player_clicker_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and 1 or -1
    local new_val = math.min(math.max(val + mod, min_val), max_val)
    if val ~= new_val then
        val = new_val
    end
    name_update()
end

-- Counter display (centered, single block)
self.createButton({
    label = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,0.9}, -- center
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 300,         -- change this to make 0/100 smaller/bigger
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

-- Label at the bottom
self.createButton({
    label = "- " .. label .. " +",
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,1.4},  -- push down
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 250,
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

label = "Supply"
text_color = {0,0,0,1}
min_val = 0
val = tonumber(self.getName()) or 10
max_val = tonumber(self.getDescription()) or 20

-- Updates name/description + the counter display
function name_update()
    self.setName(tostring(val))
    self.setDescription(tostring(max_val))
    self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val})
    self.editButton({index=1, label = val .. "/" .. max_val}) -- update display
end

-- Big invisible button for clicks
self.createButton({
    tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "increment_val",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.5,0},
    height = 1500,
    width = 1500,
    color = {0,0,0,0}
})

-- Handles increment/decrement when clicking
function increment_val(obj, player_clicker_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and 1 or -1
    local new_val = math.min(math.max(val + mod, min_val), max_val)
    if val ~= new_val then
        val = new_val
    end
    name_update()
end

-- Counter display (centered, single block)
self.createButton({
    label = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,0.9}, -- center
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 300,         -- change this to make 0/100 smaller/bigger
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

-- Label at the bottom
self.createButton({
    label = "- " .. label .. " +",
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,1.4},  -- push down
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 250,
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

label = "Supply"
text_color = {0,0,0,1}
min_val = 0
val = tonumber(self.getName()) or 10
max_val = tonumber(self.getDescription()) or 20

-- Updates name/description + the counter display
function name_update()
    self.setName(tostring(val))
    self.setDescription(tostring(max_val))
    self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val})
    self.editButton({index=1, label = val .. "/" .. max_val}) -- update display
end

-- Big invisible button for clicks
self.createButton({
    tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "increment_val",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.5,0},
    height = 1500,
    width = 1500,
    color = {0,0,0,0}
})

-- Handles increment/decrement when clicking
function increment_val(obj, player_clicker_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and 1 or -1
    local new_val = math.min(math.max(val + mod, min_val), max_val)
    if val ~= new_val then
        val = new_val
    end
    name_update()
end

-- Counter display (centered, single block)
self.createButton({
    label = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,0.9}, -- center
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 300,         -- change this to make 0/100 smaller/bigger
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

-- Label at the bottom
self.createButton({
    label = "- " .. label .. " +",
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,1.4},  -- push down
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 250,
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

function getMissileImgPath(level)
    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        hit_count = 1
    elseif hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = 
hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then
        missile_count = 4
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        missile_token = addChildToken(
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.6, 1, 0.6),
            {"missile_token", "missile_4"}
        )
        
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(missile_token))
        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

function fireMissile()
    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then
        missile_count = missile_count - 1
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end
end function getMissileImgPath(level)
    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        hit_count = 1
    elseif hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = 
hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then
        missile_count = 4
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        missile_token = addChildToken(
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.6, 1, 0.6),
            {"missile_token", "missile_4"}
        )
        
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(missile_token))
        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

function fireMissile()
    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then
        missile_count = missile_count - 1
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end
end label = "Supply"
text_color = {0,0,0,1}
min_val = 0
val = tonumber(self.getName()) or 10
max_val = tonumber(self.getDescription()) or 20

-- Updates name/description + the counter display
function name_update()
    self.setName(tostring(val))
    self.setDescription(tostring(max_val))
    self.editButton({index=0, tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val})
    self.editButton({index=1, label = val .. "/" .. max_val}) -- update display
end

-- Big invisible button for clicks
self.createButton({
    tooltip = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "increment_val",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.5,0},
    height = 1500,
    width = 1500,
    color = {0,0,0,0}
})

-- Handles increment/decrement when clicking
function increment_val(obj, player_clicker_color, alt_click)
    local mod = alt_click and 1 or -1
    local new_val = math.min(math.max(val + mod, min_val), max_val)
    if val ~= new_val then
        val = new_val
    end
    name_update()
end

-- Counter display (centered, single block)
self.createButton({
    label = val .. "/" .. max_val,
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,0.9}, -- center
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 300,         -- change this to make 0/100 smaller/bigger
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

-- Label at the bottom
self.createButton({
    label = "- " .. label .. " +",
    click_function = "null",
    function_owner = self,
    position = {0,0.1,1.4},  -- push down
    height = 0,
    width = 0,
    font_size = 250,
    font_color = text_color,
    color = {0,0,0,1}
})

function null() end
