function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)

    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do

    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        hit_count = 1
    elseif hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = 
hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then
        missile_count = 4
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        missile_token = addChildToken(
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.6, 1, 0.6),
            {"missile_token", "missile_4"}
        )
        
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(missile_token))
        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

function fireMissile()
    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then
        missile_count = missile_count - 1
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid

        end
    end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

    for _, value in pairs(tags) do

        end
    end
    
    return false

    local child = spawnObject({

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then

        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then

            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)

    end

    return count

function childTagsContain(tags, target)

    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)

    parseChildStates()

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid

            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do

    if not hit_count then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        hit_count = 1
    elseif hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = 
hit_count + 1

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(

                hit_img,
                tags

        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

    if hit_token then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
    end

        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,

    end

    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG

    if level < 15 then

    end

    if self.hasTag("Pact") then

    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)

    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)

    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then

        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then

        end
    end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)

    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",

        rotation = rotation

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)

    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

    prepToken()

end

    prepToken()

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

        res_token = nil
    end

        assist_token = nil
    end
end

            {"move_token"}

    else

        move_token = nil
    end
end

    if not res_token then

            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}

    else

        res_token = nill
    end

    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        hit_count = 1
    elseif hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = 
hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
    end
end

    if not missile_token then

        updateAttachmentImage(

            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end

            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do

    end

end

    child.setCustomObject({

        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

        thickness = 0.05

function getHitImgPath(level)

    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]

function getResImgPath()

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        hit_count = 1
    elseif hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = 
hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then

        missile_token = addChildToken(
            missile_img,

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(missile_token))
        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then
        missile_count = missile_count - 1
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end

    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]

    if self.hasTag("Pact") then

    if self.hasTag("Pact") then

    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)

    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

function getMissileImgPath(level)
    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG
end

function onObjectSpawn()
    prepToken()

end

function onLoad()
    prepToken()

end

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function clearAll()
    clearHits()

    move_token = nil
    bh_token = nil
    res_token = nil
    hit_token = nil
    missile_token = nil
    hit_count = nil
    missile_count = nil
    assist_token = nil

    self.destroyAttachments()
end

function clearTurn()
    if move_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end

    if res_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nil
    end

    if assist_token then
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleMove()


    if not move_token then
        move_token = addChildToken(
            MVD_IMG,
            MVD_IMG,
            Vector(-1,0.025,0),
            Vector(0.9,1,0.9),
            {"move_token"}
        )
    else

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(move_token))
        move_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleRes()

    if not res_token then
        local res_img = getResImgPath()
        res_token = addChildToken(
            res_img,
            res_img,
            Vector(-0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5, 1, 0.5),
            {"res_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(res_token))
        res_token = nill
    end
end

function toggleBH()

    if not bh_token then
        local bh_img = getBHImgPath()
        bh_token = addChildToken(
            bh_img,
            bh_img,
            Vector(0.4, 0.025, -1),
            Vector(0.5,1,0.5),
            {"bh_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(bh_token))
        bh_token = nil
    end
end

function toggleAssist()

    if not assist_token then
        assist_token = addChildToken(
            ASSIST_IMG,
            ASSIST_IMG,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.9, 1, 0.9),
            {"assist_token"}
        )
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(assist_token))
        assist_token = nil
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        hit_count = 1
    elseif hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = 
hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then
        missile_count = 4
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        missile_token = addChildToken(
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            Vector(1, 0.025, 0),
            Vector(0.6, 1, 0.6),
            {"missile_token", "missile_4"}
        )
        
    else
        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(missile_token))
        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

function fireMissile()
    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then
        missile_count = missile_count - 1
        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do

        end
    end

        end
    end

    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]

    if self.hasTag("Pact") then

    if self.hasTag("Pact") then

    prepToken()

    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)

    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)

    parseChildStates()

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid

            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then

        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    end

    if not hit_count then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        hit_count = 1
    elseif hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = 
hit_count + 1

        if hit_token then

        else

                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end

    if hit_token then

            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil

            missile_img,
            missile_img,

    if level == 4 then

    if level < 15 then

    parseChildStates()

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid

        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

    tbl = self.getAttachments()

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then

        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then

        end
    end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)

    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",

        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG
    end

    return BH_NATO_IMG
end

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG

    prepToken()

end

    prepToken()

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

    clearHits()

    if not hit_count then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        hit_count = 1
    elseif hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = 
hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))

function prepToken()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle RES", toggleRes)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end

function incrementHit()
    if not hit_count then
        if not isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        hit_count = 1
    elseif hit_count < 16 then
        local hit_img = getHitImgPath(hit_count)
        hit_count = 
hit_count + 1
        tags = {"hit_token", "hit_" .. tostring(hit_count)}

        if hit_token then
            updateAttachmentImage(
                hit_token,
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                tags
            )
        else
            hit_token = addChildToken(
                hit_img,
                hit_img,
                Vector(0, 0.025, 1),
                Vector(0.4, 1, 0.4),
                tags
            )
        end
    end
end

function clearHits()
    if hit_token then
        if isFlipped() then
            self.flip()
        end

        self.destroyAttachment(findChildByGUID(hit_token))
        hit_token = nil
        hit_count = nil
    end
end

function toggleMissiles()
    if not missile_token then

        missile_token = nil
        missile_count = nil
    end
end

    if missile_token and missile_count > 0 then

        local missile_img = getMissileImgPath(missile_count)
        updateAttachmentImage(
            missile_token,
            missile_img,
            missile_img,
            {"missile_token", "missile_" .. tostring(missile_count)}     
        )
    end

    end

    return count

    if level == 4 then
        return MSL_4_IMG
    elseif level == 3 then
        return MSL_3_IMG
    elseif level == 2 then
        return MSL_2_IMG
    elseif level == 1 then
        return MSL_1_IMG
    end

    return MSL_0_IMG
end

function getHitImgPath(level)
    if level < 15 then
        return HIT_IMGS[level]
    end

    return HIT_IMGS[15]
end

function getBHImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return BH_PACT_IMG

    return BH_NATO_IMG

function getResImgPath()
    if self.hasTag("Pact") then
        return RES_PACT_IMG
    end

    return RES_NATO_IMG

    prepToken()

    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle move", toggleMove)

    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle BH", toggleBH)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle Committed", toggleAssist)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Add hit", incrementHit)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Clear hits", clearHits)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle missiles", toggleMissiles)
    self.addContextMenuItem("Fire missile", fireMissile)

    parseChildStates()
end

function parseChildStates()
    for _, child in ipairs(self.getAttachments()) do
        log(child)
        local tags = child.tags

        if childTagsContain(tags, "move_token") then
            move_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "bh_token") then
            bh_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "res_token") then
            res_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "assist_token") then
            assist_token = child.guid
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "hit_token") then
            hit_token = child.guid
            hit_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "hit_", 15)
        elseif childTagsContain(tags, "missile_token") then
            missile_token = child.guid
            missile_count = parseChildTagNumeric(tags, "missile_", 4)
        end
    end
end

function parseChildTagNumeric(tags, prefix, max)
    count = nill
    for counter = 0,max do
        if childTagsContain(tags, prefix .. tostring(counter)) then
            count = counter
            break
        end
    end

    return count
end

function childTagsContain(tags, target)
    for _, value in pairs(tags) do
        if value == target then
            return true
        end
    end
    
    return false
end

function addChildToken(image, image_bottom, pos, scale, tags)
    local location = self.positionToWorld(self.positionToLocal(self.getPosition()) + pos)
    local rotation = self.getRotation()
    local corrected_scale = scale * self.getScale()

    local child = spawnObject({
        type = "Custom_Tile",
        sound = false,
        position = location,
        scale = corrected_scale,
        rotation = rotation
    })

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)

    return child.guid

end

function updateAttachmentImage(guid, image, image_bottom, tags)
    local child = self.removeAttachment(findChildByGUID(guid))

    child.setCustomObject({
        image = image,
        image_bottom = image_bottom,
        thickness = 0.05
    })
    child.setTags(tags)
    self.addAttachment(child)
end

function findChildByGUID(guid)
    tbl = self.getAttachments()
    for i, v in ipairs(tbl) do
        if v.guid == guid then
            return v.index
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

function isFlipped()
    local flip_angle = self.getRotation().z

    if flip_angle > 90 and flip_angle < 270 then
        return true
    end
end
